newsitem.title: GERMANY: Further coffee price rise needed - German roaster.
newsitem.headline: Further coffee price rise needed - German roaster.

text.p: Germany's second largest coffee roaster Tchbio Frisch-Roest-Kaffee GmbH sees the need for further retail price rises against the background of dramatic futures rallies, a spokeswoman said on Friday.
"We will monitor the situation closely...we need to safeguard the high quality of our coffees," she said. "If the situation stays at it is, further prices rises will be inevitable."
But she could not set a date or the specify the size of the possible increase.
Tchibo prices were last in a 8.99-10.99 marks per 500 grams packet range.
The international Coffee Organization (ICO) 15-day price of arabica coffees surged to a 20-year high of 325.98 cents a lb on Thursday.
